outcome: Uncomplicated pregnancy and birth (delivery of a term live-born infant without antenatal or labour complications)
cohort: The study participants were 1409 obese women (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) with singleton pregnancies from the UPBEAT trial.
finding: Multiparity, increased plasma adiponectin, maternal age, systolic blood pressure, and HbA1c were independently associated with uncomplicated pregnancy and birth, demonstrating that clinical factors and biomarkers can help stratify pregnancy and delivery risk among obese women.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery increased across the fifths of increasing predicted risk of uncomplicated pregnancy and birth.
gest_age: Exposures measured at 15+0 to 18+6 weeks' gestation; outcome defined as delivery of a term live-born infant.
